title: PEFT-U: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for User Personalization

bias_targets.methodology: Reconstructing subjective NLP datasets (e.g., hate speech, sentiment analysis, humor) to treat individual annotators as distinct users, filtering for high annotator disagreement (low Krippendorff's alpha), and evaluating how well Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods can predict user-specific labels compared to generalized, 'one-size-fits-all' prompting.
